```scala
package examples.dsl

import scala.language.implicitConversions

import menger.dsl._

/**
 * A gold Menger sponge at level 2 (VolumeFilling, the classic cube-removing Menger sponge).
 *
 * Level 2 leaves 400 cubes: the characteristic fractal of holes, lit by a three-point
 * setup so the inner faces read clearly.
 */
object GoldMengerSponge:
  val scene = Scene(
    camera = Camera(
      position = (4f, 3f, 6f),
      lookAt = (0f, 0f, 0f)
    ),
    objects = List(
      Sponge(
        pos = (0f, 0f, 0f),
        spongeType = VolumeFilling,
        level = 2f,
        material = Some(Material.Gold),
        size = 2.5f
      )
    ),
    lights = List(
      Directional(direction = (1f, -1f, -1f), intensity = 1.5f),
      Directional(direction = (-1f, -0.5f, -1f), intensity = 0.5f),
      Directional(direction = (0f, 0.5f, 1f), intensity = 0.8f)
    ),
    planes = List(Plane(Y at -2, color = "#404040"))
  )

  SceneRegistry.register("gold-menger-sponge", scene)
```

level-2 volume-filling gold sponge, 2.5 units, three directional lights (one upper area travelling +x/-z, one upper travelling -x/-z, one from below travelling +z), dark grey ground plane, camera 7.8 units out looking at the origin.
